text: Brightline, a payments company in Austin, acquired Oakfield for $40 million.
Maya Chen, CEO of Brightline, says the Oakfield team will stay in Denver.
Brightline plans to buy Westpeak, a Boston lender, next year.
Contrary to earlier reports, Raj Patel is not the CEO of Westpeak.
Westpeak named Ana Ruiz its CEO in 2023.
